answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 14209 Country: India Title: Assalamualykum warahmatullahi wabarakatahu, Is it compulsory to shave the head while performing Umrah ? or can i cut my hair small, kindly prove through Hadees, Jazakh Allah khair! Question: Assalamualykum warahmatullahi wabarakatahu, Is it compulsory to shave the head while performing Umrah ? or can i cut my hair small, kindly prove through Hadees, Jazakh Allah khair! Answer ID: 14209 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1148/1087=B/1430) It is not necessary to shave head after Umrah, rather it is permissible to trim the hair to wajib extent: کما ف ي صحیح البخاري: أن النبي علیہ السلام أذن لأصحابہ أن یجعلوھا عمرۃ یطوفوا ثم یقصروا ویحلوا إلا من کان معہ الھدي ( رقم الحدیث /240 2:239 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
